newsitem.title: CANADA: BASEBALL-MARLINS PUT FLOYD BACK ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-MARLINS PUT FLOYD BACK ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: The Florida Marlins put outfielder Cliff Floyd back on the disabled list Saturday with a pulled left hamstring.
Floyd aggravated the injury running out a ground ball in Friday's 2-1 win over the Montreal Expos. It is the same injury that landed him on the disabled list from May 9 to 24.

Floyd, acquired from the Expos just before the start of the season, is hitting only .221 with two homers and five RBI in 38 games. The 24-year-old has already fought his way back from a serious injury to his left wrist suffered in May 1995.
The Marlins replaced Floyd on the roster by recalling outfielder Billy McMillon from Charlotte of the International League (AAA). McMillon was hitting .280 at Charlotte with eight homers and 26 RBI.
